items.line: Ember, i train until my arms burn. strength wins the arena, and rank follows it.
Brennic thinks he leads the tent. i will watch him, and i will remember my own arena win.
Ember won the last games. train hard and keep the order, or lose what we held.
cassia, i have bread to spare and a little time. walk with me, and we may both be better fed.
as i wrote in my treatise, discipline of mind precedes the contest. ember won before, and we must study why.
we keep strong, for family and for the day we walk out.
i will earn my place in this tent by honest work.
Garran, you and I could be more than a tent's leftovers. think on it, after the Door falls.
let me see which way the lanista's purse leans before i lean with it.
i will run the drills twice over, and bet the gale takes the next games.
a purse stays full by honest work, so i will earn mine today and keep my eyes open.
the Vigil keeps its eyes upon the strays, that the peace of the camp may hold.
the ember tent won the last games, friends, so let us see if the favourite still carries the crowd.
